financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Underwritten public offering of Class A common stock (closing expected on or about Dec 5, 2022)
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: We estimate the net proceeds from this offering will be approximately $9.84 million, after deducting underwriting discounts and commissions and estimated offering expenses payable by us.

warrants.quote: issued to SWK Funding LLC a warrant (the “Warrant”) to purchase, in the aggregate, up to 187,969 shares of Class A common stock of the Company, $0.001 par value per share at an exercise price of $6.65 per share.
